raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: libsecp256k1-py-bindings
  version: "0.8.0.1"

  qemu_arch: ${{ target_platform | replace("linux-64", "x86_64") | replace("linux-", "") }}
  qemu_pkg: ${{ "qemu-execve-" ~ qemu_arch ~ '[version=">=11", build_number=">=10"]' if linux and build_platform != target_platform else "" }}
  sysroot: ${{ "/" ~ target_platform | replace("linux", "") | replace("-64", "x86_64") | replace("-ppc64le", "powerpc64le") | replace("-", "") ~ "-conda-linux-gnu/sysroot" if linux else "" }}
  is_checkable: ${{ build_platform == target_platform or build_platform in ["linux-64", "osx-arm64"] }}
  is_qemuable: ${{ linux and build_platform != target_platform }}

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/MementoRC/libsecp256k1-py-bindings/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 02623c9d7095c96c943d43e66c9442b6114716462f190d9d80257f42756b090d

build:
  number: 1
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-build-isolation --use-pep517 -vvv

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - pkg-config
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cffi >=1.3.0
  host:
    - cffi >=1.3.0
    - libsecp256k1 >=0.8.0,<0.9
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools >=61
  run:
    - asn1crypto
    - ${{ pin_compatible('cffi') }}
    - python

tests:
  - if: is_checkable
    then:
      python:
        imports:
          - libsecp256k1_py_bindings
        pip_check: true

  - script:
      - if: is_qemuable
        then:
          - export QEMU_EXECVE="${QEMU_EXECVE:-$(command -v qemu-execve-${{ qemu_arch }} || true)}"
          - export QEMU_LD_PREFIX="${PREFIX}${{ sysroot }}"
          - export QEMU_EXECVE_NATIVE_PASSTHROUGH=1
          - $QEMU_EXECVE $PREFIX/bin/python -m pytest -v tests
        else:
          - pytest -v tests
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: is_qemuable
          then:
            - ${{ qemu_pkg }}
      run:
        - pytest
        - pytest-benchmark <5.3
        - if: is_qemuable
          then:
            - sysroot_${{ target_platform }}
    files:
      source:
        - tests/

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/MementoRC/${{ name }}
  summary: Cross-platform Python CFFI bindings for libsecp256k1 (CFFI from Coincurve)
  documentation: https://ofek.dev/coincurve/
  description: |
    This library provides well-tested Python bindings for libsecp256k1,
    the heavily optimized C library used by Bitcoin Core for operations
    on the elliptic curve secp256k1. It is a streamlined version of Coincurve
  license: MIT OR Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE-MIT
    - LICENSE-APACHE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ofek
    - MementoRC
